description: Under the foyer, and older than it: a brick undercroft with a barrel ceiling, half of it taken up by the building's junction cabinet and the rest by racking. The racking holds film cans, stacked flat, four deep, labelled in a hand that stopped being used some time ago. A dehumidifier runs in the corner because the alternative is vinegar, and anybody who has smelled a reel go that way runs one too.
name: Reel Estate — The Foyer — Utility Room
